reasons: narrow: The frozen pointwise outcome-equivariance clause is incompatible with the constructed schedules under the declared left shift \((\theta u)_j=u_{j+1}\). For example, for the constant-one assignment under \(P^+\), it requires \(Y_{i+1}(\theta d;\theta U,\theta G)=Y_i(d;U,G)\), but the two sides are \(U_{i+2}\) and \(U_i\), which differ with positive probability under iid Rademacher innovations. Hence \(P^+\notin\mathcal M_{2,\mathrm{loc}}\) as the class is written, so the original membership conclusion is false. The proposed claim removes only that conclusion and the unverified exposure/outcome equivariance clauses, while retaining every directly verified primitive and both exact covariance calculations.
